component: IMAP next-UID tracking and cache boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The tracking patch passes ImapUid through the STATUS comparison and SetServerCounts instead of signed temporaries. Folder cache persistence still uses GetCachedInt32 with a pointer cast and SetCachedInt32 with a value cast. The original missing sentinel is ImapUid_None; accepted later code uses zero. This is a bounded type and serialization boundary, not a cache format migration or demonstrated full-range round trip. No tests change.
title: Next-UID tracking changes type while the folder cache keeps signed casts
